factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments table shows Total capital investments for Jan-Jun 2026: EUR 37,458 thousand (37.458M, +57.9%). Breakdown includes IT systems (14,174 thousand), Mobile network (6,116 thousand), 5G spectrum licenses (9,690 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: Major operational developments during the period included acquiring 40 MHz of 1,500 MHz frequencies for nearly EUR 8 million and extending the right to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band for EUR 2 million to advance 5G network development, alongside commencing the construction of a new data center near Vilnius with planned investments of up to EUR 26 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report states: 'In June, we acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million... received the largest share of these frequencies sold – 40 MHz... Also extended the right to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band... EUR 2 million... In 2026, Telia Lietuva commenced construction of a new data center near Vilnius... plans to invest up to EUR 26 million...'

factual_claims.claim: Following the annual general meeting decision in May 2026, the company distributed a record EUR 81.6 million in dividends, or EUR 0.14 per share, for the year 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends section states: 'On 21 May 2026, the Company paid out to the shareholders an amount of EUR 81.6 million of dividends or EUR 0.14 per share for the year 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets as of June 30, 2026, stood at EUR 623.2 million, with shareholders equity amounting to EUR 372.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position shows Total assets as at 30-Jun-2026: EUR 623,203 thousand (623.203M), Shareholders' equity: EUR 372,043 thousand (372.043M).

numerical_claims.claim: Total revenue for the six-month period ended June 30, 2026, grew by 7.2 per cent to reach EUR 259.1 million compared to EUR 241.7 million in the same period of 2025.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table: Revenue Jan-Jun 2026 = 259,084 thousand EUR (259.084M), Jan-Jun 2025 = 241,674 thousand EUR (241.674M), change = 7.2%.

numerical_claims.claim: Fixed services revenue increased by 5.3 per cent to EUR 112.9 million, mobile services revenue rose by 8.3 per cent to EUR 100.0 million, and equipment sales revenue grew by 9.6 per cent to EUR 46.1 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Fixed: 112.9M EUR, Mobile: 100.0M EUR, Equipment: 46.1M EUR
numerical_claims.source_value: Fixed: 112,920 thousand EUR, Mobile: 100,022 thousand EUR, Equipment: 46,142 thousand EUR
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Revenue table: Fixed services Jan-Jun 2026 = 112,920 thousand EUR (112.92M), Mobile services = 100,022 thousand EUR (100.02M), Equipment = 46,142 thousand EUR (46.14M). Percent changes match.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA increased by 9.5 per cent to EUR 105.5 million, exceeding the EUR 100 million threshold for an interim period for the first time, with the EBITDA margin standing at 40.7 per cent compared to 39.9 per cent a year ago.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table: EBITDA Jan-Jun 2026 = 105,468 thousand EUR (105.468M, rounded to 105.5M), margin = 40.7% vs 2025 margin = 39.9%.

numerical_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items grew by 10.2 per cent to EUR 106.9 million, resulting in an adjusted EBITDA margin of 41.3 per cent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table: Adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items Jan-Jun 2026 = 106,899 thousand EUR (106.899M, rounded to 106.9M), margin = 41.3%.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit, or EBIT, rose by 15.1 per cent to EUR 62.4 million, while profit for the period increased by 14.7 per cent to EUR 51.3 million compared to EUR 44.7 million in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EBIT: 62.4 million EUR, Profit: 51.3 million EUR
numerical_claims.source_value: EBIT: 62,420 thousand EUR, Profit: 51,326 thousand EUR
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Earnings table: EBIT Jan-Jun 2026 = 62,420 thousand EUR (62.42M, rounded to 62.4M), Profit = 51,326 thousand EUR (51.33M, rounded to 51.3M). Comparisons to 2025 values show +15.1% and +14.7% respectively.

numerical_claims.claim: Basic and diluted earnings per share went up by 14.7 per cent to EUR 0.088.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per share table: Basic/Diluted EPS Jan-Jun 2026 = 0.088 EUR (+14.7% vs 2025: 0.077 EUR).

numerical_claims.claim: Non-recurring redundancy expenses of EUR 1.4 million associated with the restructuring of the digital and technology unit.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section: 'Non-recurring expenses for the first half of 2026 were... comprised from one-off redundancy pay-outs of EUR 324 thousand... and non-recurring other expenses of EUR 31 thousand... For the first half of 2026 non-recurring redundancy expenses amounted to EUR 1.4 million...'

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses excluding non-recurring items rose by 10.2 per cent to EUR 67.3 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Expenses table: Operating expenses (excl. non-recurring expenses) Jan-Jun 2026 = 67,323 thousand EUR (67.323M, rounded to 67.3M), change = +10.2%.
